title: Selecting and re-embedding a configuration
statement: Let $m$ and $k$ be nonnegative integers, let $S$ and $\Gamma$ be types, let $x$ be a finite input string over $\Gamma$, and let $\sigma$ be an injective map from the $m$ tape indices to the $k$ tape indices. For every $k$-tape configuration $d$ on input $x$, selecting the tapes indexed by $\sigma$ to form an $m$-tape configuration with the same state and input-head position and empty output, then embedding it back using $d$'s work-tape contents and head positions on the other tapes and $d$'s output as the prefix, recovers $d$ exactly.
hypotheses_covered: An injective map from the $m$ tape indices to the $k$ tape indices
